name: Lyo.Diagram
tagline: Build a diagram from pages and cells, and read or write it as a draw.io mxfile.
description:
Turns a [`DiagramDocument`](../Lyo.Diagram.Models/README.md) into a diagrams.net file and back. `DiagramBuilder` adds rectangle, rounded, ellipse, and diamond shapes plus an orthogonal connector. Any other draw.io style string can be passed through.

`DiagramDrawIo.Export` writes an uncompressed `<mxfile>` that diagrams.net opens directly. `DiagramDrawIo.Import` reads that file and the compressed form diagrams.net saves by default (base64 of raw DEFLATE of `encodeURIComponent` applied to the `mxGraphModel` XML). Import assigns a new document id. The name comes from the `mxfile` `name` attribute, otherwise the first page name.

`InMemoryDiagramStore` implements `IDiagramStore` for hosts that do not open PostgreSQL. Persist with [`Lyo.Diagram.Postgres`](../Lyo.Diagram.Postgres/README.md).
features: **Builder.** `DiagramBuilder` / `DiagramPageBuilder` with `DiagramShapeKind` presets, a raw style overload, `Size` for the page, and `Connect` waypoints plus anchors.
**draw.io.** Uncompressed export and import of uncompressed or compressed mxfiles, including pages, labels, styles, geometry, waypoints, parents, and edge endpoints.
**Memory store.** `InMemoryDiagramStore` upserts by id and lists summaries without requiring the caller to read cells.

examples.title: Build a page and export it
In-memory store

sections.title: What round-trips
sections.text: Pages, labels, style strings, bounds, relative edge geometry, waypoints, source and target points, parent links, and edge endpoints. Export always emits the draw.io root cells (`id="0"` and `id="1"`). Import drops them. Editor viewport (`dx` / `dy`) and embedded image binaries are left out.
